about: Coding harnesses Living Brain plans to support. Source of truth: Livingbrain-wiki/livingbrain#38. Every entry is planned; none is tested yet. tools/marks.js generates the logo rows on /, /agents/ and /integrations/ from this file. Logos: Simple Icons 16.33.0 (CC0 SVG path data); the names and marks are trademarks of their owners and are used only to say what Living Brain is planned to work with. Not affiliated with or endorsed by these companies.
